commits.subject: Provide no-op logs providers in SQS span-link test fixtures

batches.analysis: Both newly added AWS SDK SQS link tests use an incomplete OpenTelemetry mock. Existing exception-log preview checks initialize a logger before testing links, causing a null-provider failure. Stub getLogsBridge() with the real no-op logs provider alongside the existing no-op meter provider in both fixtures.
batches.downsides: Adds one fixture stub per SDK version. The fixtures intentionally use no-op logging and do not assert exception log emission; existing dedicated exception tests retain that coverage.
batches.summary: Provide no-op logs providers in SQS span-link test fixtures
batches.upsides: Allows both normal and exception-log preview suites to exercise the same link assertions, including invalid contexts, without changing production behavior or weakening existing CI checks.

diagnoses.analysis: This is the downstream status gate, not a separate source failure. The frozen reusable-pr-build.yml:62-89 explicitly exits 1 when common or test-latest-deps is unsuccessful, matching the eight recorded AWS SDK log-mode test failures. Repair their shared new test fixture; preserve the gate unchanged. A passing gate remains dependent on subsequent CI.

build / common / test2 (21, hotspot): both AWS SDK library testExceptionSignalLogs tasks fail only in the PR-added SqsReceiveSpanLinksTest. Their mocked OpenTelemetry supplies tracer and meter providers but leaves getLogsBridge() null. The existing logs-preview variant makes Instrumenter construction call InstrumenterBuilder.buildLogger at line 336 before link assertions. Supply OpenTelemetry.noop().getLogsBridge() in both new fixtures, without disabling the preview variant or weakening assertions. This repairs a PR-introduced fixture defect, not an SDK-version or JDK failure.
